criteria.requirement: CHIRP, TRANSFORM and ZIGZAG use one fixed 125 ms capture window per effect entry.
SPEED 0.25, 1.0 and 4.0 changes only the BPM-synchronised motion cycle.
CHIRP performs smooth forward and reverse motion with its specified 80/20 gate.
TRANSFORM performs smooth round trips with four 50/50 cuts per cycle.
LENGTH, DEPTH and the existing approximately 8 ms wet transition are preserved.
Thirty milliseconds of process-before-effect dual-channel silence latches the current BAR dry; short gaps do not.
Transport STOP, seek and loop invalidate active motion safely and do not replay stale capture.
Normal BAR transitions, Host Sync ON/OFF and 64 BAR playback remain continuous.
OFF, BABY, FORWARD CUT, BACKSPIN, TAPE BRAKE and DRAG behavior has no regression.
Output is finite and click-safe with no realtime allocation, mutex, ValueTree access, logging or I/O.
All five LENGTH values and SPEED 0.25, 1.0 and 4.0 produce diagnostic WAV coverage.
